title: Workspace model IO boundary eval
purpose: Verify provider-neutral CandidatePlan output normalization before RustWorkspacePlan projection and WorkspacePlan validation.

cases.intent: Direct provider JSON parses as a valid candidate plan
Provider envelope with candidate_plan parses to the nested plan
